skill.name: parallel-task
skill.description: Coordinates explicit /parallel-task requests by parsing a markdown plan, launching dependency-aware subagents, validating work, and updating the plan.
skill.summary: Run dependency-aware implementation tasks in parallel from a markdown plan.
skill.author: am-will

content.value_statement: Large implementation plans are slow when each task waits unnecessarily. This skill coordinates dependency-aware subagents so independent tasks can run, validate, commit, and log progress.
actual_capabilities: Parses markdown plan files for task IDs, names, dependencies, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and validation steps.
Filters requested task subsets and includes required dependencies before execution.
Launches unblocked tasks in parallel waves based on the depends_on list.
Defaults task work to a RED to GREEN test-first workflow when tasks are testable.
Validates subagent outputs, local commits, plan logs, and completion status before continuing.
Produces an execution summary with completed tasks, issues, blockers, files changed, and next steps.
limitations: Requires a clear markdown plan with task IDs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and validation steps.
Works best in repositories where multiple tasks can be changed and committed independently.
Does not replace human review of subagent outputs, commits, or test evidence.
Can create local commits because the workflow instructs agents to commit completed tasks.

use_cases.title: Parallel Feature Delivery
use_cases.description: Run independent plan tasks at the same time while preserving dependency order and local commit history.

use_cases.title: TDD Plan Execution
use_cases.description: Require test-first evidence, implementation, validation, and task-log updates for each planned work item.

use_cases.title: Large Refactor Coordination
use_cases.description: Split refactor plans into waves so reviewers can inspect completed tasks and unresolved blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a complete markdown plan.

prompt_templates.title: Run Selected Tasks
prompt_templates.scenario: Execute only named tasks and required dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Resume a Blocked Wave
prompt_templates.prompt:
/parallel-task ./plans/refactor-plan.md --tasks T5 T6 T7
Focus on existing task logs and validate previous commits before launching new work.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a TDD Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Use strict validation for a risky implementation plan.
prompt_templates.prompt:
/parallel-task ./plans/payments-plan.md
Require RED to GREEN evidence for testable tasks and document any non-testable verification before committing.

output_examples.input: User asks to run a plan with four independent tasks and two dependent tasks.
output: The skill launches the first four tasks in parallel, waits for validation, then starts the dependent wave.
It returns modified files, verification evidence, commits, and plan updates.

output_examples.input: User requests only tasks T3 and T7.
output_examples.output: The skill includes required dependencies, skips unrelated work, and reports any missing task IDs before execution.

output_examples.input: A subagent cannot validate a task.
output_examples.output: The skill records the blocker, asks for retry or escalation, and keeps dependent tasks blocked until resolved.

best_practices: Write task IDs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and validation commands before invoking the skill.
Keep independent tasks in separate files or modules when possible to reduce merge conflicts.
Review each local commit and plan log before starting the next wave.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague plans that omit dependencies or validation expectations.
Do not run the skill on untrusted plans without reviewing commands and file paths first.
Do not expect parallel work to succeed when tasks edit the same code paths heavily.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when a markdown implementation plan has independent tasks that can run in dependency-aware parallel waves.

faq.question: Does it run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The description limits activation to explicit /parallel-task commands from the user.

faq.question: Can it execute only part of a plan?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request specific task IDs, and the skill includes their required dependencies.

faq.question: Does it create commits?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow tells agents to create local commits for completed tasks and never push them.

faq.question: How does it handle tests?
faq.answer: It defaults to RED to GREEN test evidence for testable tasks and requires alternate evidence for non-testable tasks.

faq.question: What should my plan include?
faq.answer: Include task IDs, dependencies, descriptions, file locations, acceptance criteria, and concrete validation steps.
